svg.title: Installing only the source publication component: A complete project cannot be replaced by a component install
svg.text: Installing only the source publication component
Scenario: A complete project cannot be replaced by a component install

g.text: Given a project whose main branch already carries the complete framework and its own Copier
GitLab's page for the answers file on the main branch of a project that already uses the complete framework. Copier
wrote it, the developer pushed it, and it records the project's own choices: "container_runtime: podman",
The developer's copy also holds a tool and a private file of its own. Before the installer runs, the test records every
file of the project, its content and its permissions.
When the developer ticks source publication on the checklist
The developer runs the installer anyway and answers "Choose components". A checklist opens,
and the developer ticks "Source publication" alone. The picture is taken before Enter,
because the checklist erases itself once it is answered.
Then the installer refuses, names the update path, and leaves the project exactly as the
The installer stops before copying anything. It says the answers file "already describes a complete framework
installation", and gives the command that turns publication on through the project's own update: task copier:update with
Then the developer types git status. Git answers "nothing to commit, working tree clean": the project is still exactly
what the main branch on GitLab holds. The test also compares every file, its content and its permissions with what it
